pool.text: Geologist Albert Ernest Kitson discovered coal in Enugu for export through the city.
The building of a port-town was started after land ceding by Diobu people.
Governor Sir Frederick Lugard named Port Harcourt in honor of Lewis Harcourt.
Port Harcourt started from an area of 15.54 km2 in the city.
A 375-bed facility was founded to provide general and specialist medical services.
The population of Port Harcourt was counted as 59,752 residents.
Crude oil was discovered in Oloibiri leading to new economic activity.
The first shipment of Nigerian crude oil was exported through the city.
Port Harcourt fell to Nigerian forces during the secession of the Republic of Biafra.
Radio Rivers was founded to offer programs in English and indigenous languages.
The Port Harcourt Book Festival was incepted and remains an important event.
The Authority was established by law to facilitate the implementation of the master plan.
Water sector and utility reforms were initiated in Rivers State.
UNESCO and international bodies named Port Harcourt the World Book Capital.
Slim Burna sang a song called Port Harcourt Boy from his release.
More than 5 local FM stations were commercially licensed in the city.
The Port Harcourt Water Corporation formally took off with a recruitment mandate.
The University of Port Harcourt was ranked sixth in Africa by Times Higher Education.
The metropolitan area population reached an estimate by the United Nations.
Roseline Konya stated a high reading for air pollution in the city.
